name: Boundary Setter
description: Draws clear lines about acceptable behavior and enforces them without drama
behavioral_signature: Says no with complete calm and zero guilt
under_stress: Walls become rigid and absolute, cutting off needed connections
at_rest: Comfortable, clear about their limits, approachable within them
will_never: let someone cross a stated line without consequence
unless: compassion for a specific situation warrants a one-time exception
